error.storage: Browser storage is unavailable. Your current input still works.
error.name: Enter a cabinet name.
error.profileNotSaved: Connected, but this browser cannot save the profile. Enter it again after closing the page.
error.card: Card numbers need 16 hexadecimal characters (0–9, A–F).
error.savePassword: Enable an API password in spice2x and connect with it to save settings.
error.apply: Calibration failed. Adjust again before saving: {detail}
error.saveMismatch: Settings changed after saving. Reload and check the cabinet settings.
error.controlPassword: Connect with an API password to use system actions.
error.button: The cabinet does not provide a {label} button.
error.cardsChanged: Connection changed. Read the cards again.
error.noCapture: No screen is available for capture.
error.jpeg: No valid JPEG was returned. This build may not support capture.
error.demoCapture: Demo mode does not connect for capture.
error.resizeFormat: Invalid calibration response. Use a spice2x build with the Resize API.
error.endpoint: Enter a complete WebSocket endpoint, e.g. ws://192.168.1.10:1338.
error.endpointProtocol: Use ws:// or wss://. Enter the password in the API password field.
error.connectTimeout: Connection timed out. Check the endpoint, port and local-network permission.
error.websocket: WebSocket failed. Check the cabinet API, network and browser local-network permission.
error.connectionLost: Cabinet connection closed. Reconnect to continue.
error.changed: Connection changed; this action was not sent.
error.apiTimeout: API timed out. Connection closed to preserve cipher state. Check the API password and reconnect.
error.tooLarge: API response exceeds the size limit.
error.parse: API could not parse the request. Check the API password.
error.extra: Extra API response data; connection closed.
error.response: API response format or request ID does not match.
error.key: API did not provide a valid session key.
